preconditions.description: Garden dimensions n and m are within bounds, and k important squares are within valid limits.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= aij <= 1000 for row in a for aij in row)
preconditions.description: Each flower count aij in the garden is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(important_squares) == k and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in important_squares)
preconditions.description: Exactly k important squares are provided, each with valid coordinates.

preconditions.expression: all((x1, y1) != (x2, y2) for i, (x1, y1) in enumerate(important_squares) for (x2, y2) in important_squares[i+1:])
preconditions.description: All important squares have distinct coordinates.

postconditions.expression: min_dead_plants == sum(a[i-1][j-1] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, m+1) if plan[i-1][j-1] == 'X')
postconditions.description: min_dead_plants is the sum of flower counts for all squares covered with concrete ('X').

postconditions.expression: all(plan[i-1][j-1] == 'X' for i, j in important_squares)
postconditions.description: All important squares are covered with concrete ('X').

postconditions.expression: all(any(plan[x1-1][y1-1] == 'X' and plan[x2-1][y2-1] == 'X' and connected(x1, y1, x2, y2, plan) for x1, y1 in important_squares) for x2, y2 in important_squares)
postconditions.description: There exists a path of concrete-covered squares ('X') between every pair of important squares, where connected(x1, y1, x2, y2, plan) is true if there is a path from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) using adjacent 'X' squares.

postconditions.expression: not any(sum(a[i-1][j-1] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, m+1) if plan[i-1][j-1] == 'X') < min_dead_plants)
postconditions.description: min_dead_plants is the minimum possible total flower count for any valid concrete plan.

postconditions.expression: len(plan) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in plan) and all(row in ['X', '.'] * m for row in plan)
postconditions.description: The plan is an n x m grid of 'X' or '.' characters.
